title: FDA MAUDE Injection Device Events 2020-2026
subtitle: 39,480 openFDA reports on syringes and pen injectors, with recalls and 510(k)s
description:
Public openFDA data pulled Nov 24 2026 for product codes FMF, MEG, NSC, PQX and KZH (piston and antistick syringes, pen injectors, epinephrine syringes, syringe needle introducers).

- maude_events.parquet: 39,480 MAUDE reports received 2020-01 to 2026-10 (narrative, event type, manufacturer, FDA product-problem codes)
- recall.jsonl.gz: 332 device recalls
- 510k.jsonl.gz: 964 510(k) records

Source: U.S. FDA via openFDA (public domain). Code and results: https://github.com/ByteBoss123/injection-device-safety-signals
